# ISummerGovernorV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerGovernorV2.sol)

**Inherits:**
IGovernor, [ISummerGovernorErrors](../errors/i-summer-governor-errors.md)

**Title:**
ISummerGovernorV2 Interface

Governance V2 hub-and-satellite interface extending OZ Governor. Voting occurs on the hub with xSUMR.
Finalized proposals may be distributed cross-chain to satellites via LayerZero and queued for execution.

Key behaviors:
- Hub-only: propose, castVote, execute, cancel. Satellite-only: receive and queue cross-chain proposals.
- ETH receive is restricted to LayerZero endpoint or timelock executors to avoid accidental funding.
- Guardians (via ProtocolAccessManager) can propose below threshold and have scoped cancellation privileges.


## Functions
### castVote

Casts a vote for a proposal on the hub chain.


```solidity
function castVote(uint256 proposalId, uint8 support) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|The proposal to vote on|
|`support`|`uint8`|0 = Against, 1 = For, 2 = Abstain|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|proposalId The proposal ID (echo)|


### propose

Creates a new proposal. Hub-only.


```solidity
function propose(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    string memory description
)
    external
    override(IGovernor)
    returns (uint256 proposalId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|Call targets|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|ETH values for each call|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|Calldata payloads|
|`description`|`string`|Human-readable description|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|New proposal ID|


### execute

Executes a successful proposal from the hub chain. Timelock-enforced.


```solidity
function execute(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    bytes32 descriptionHash
)
    external
    payable
    override(IGovernor)
    returns (uint256 proposalId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|Call targets|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|ETH values|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|Calldata payloads|
|`descriptionHash`|`bytes32`|EIP-712 description hash|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|Executed proposal ID|


### cancel

Cancels a proposal. Hub-only. Guardians have scoped privileges.


```solidity
function cancel(
    address[] memory targets,
    uint256[] memory values,
    bytes[] memory calldatas,
    bytes32 descriptionHash
)
    external
    override(IGovernor)
    returns (uint256 proposalId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|Call targets|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|ETH values|
|`calldatas`|`bytes[]`|Calldata payloads|
|`descriptionHash`|`bytes32`|EIP-712 description hash|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|Cancelled proposal ID|


### sendProposalToTargetChain

Sends a finalized proposal to a satellite for queuing and execution via LayerZero.


```solidity
function sendProposalToTargetChain(
    uint32 _dstEid,
    address[] memory _dstTargets,
    uint256[] memory _dstValues,
    bytes[] memory _dstCalldatas,
    bytes32 _dstDescriptionHash,
    bytes calldata _options
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_dstEid`|`uint32`|Destination Endpoint ID|
|`_dstTargets`|`address[]`|Targets for destination chain|
|`_dstValues`|`uint256[]`|ETH values for destination chain|
|`_dstCalldatas`|`bytes[]`|Calldata payloads for destination chain|
|`_dstDescriptionHash`|`bytes32`|EIP-712 description hash for destination chain|
|`_options`|`bytes`|LayerZero executor options|


### isActiveGuardian

Returns whether an account is an active guardian according to the ProtocolAccessManager.


```solidity
function isActiveGuardian(address account) external view returns (bool isGuardian);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|Address to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`isGuardian`|`bool`|True if the account is an active guardian|


## Events
### ProposalSentCrossChain
Emitted when a proposal is sent cross-chain to a destination endpoint.


```solidity
event ProposalSentCrossChain(uint256 indexed proposalId, uint32 indexed dstEid);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|Proposal ID on the destination chain (hash of destination data)|
|`dstEid`|`uint32`|Destination LayerZero Endpoint ID|

### ProposalReceivedCrossChain
Emitted when a cross-chain proposal is received via LayerZero.


```solidity
event ProposalReceivedCrossChain(uint256 indexed proposalId, uint32 indexed srcEid);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalId`|`uint256`|Proposal ID computed from destination payload|
|`srcEid`|`uint32`|Source LayerZero Endpoint ID|

## Structs
### GovernorParams
Deployment parameters for the governor.

`proposalThreshold` is validated within [MIN_PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD; MAX_PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD].


```solidity
struct GovernorParams {
    IVotes token;
    SummerTimelockController timelock;
    address accessManager;
    uint48 votingDelay;
    uint32 votingPeriod;
    uint256 proposalThreshold;
    uint256 quorumFraction;
    address endpoint;
    uint32 hubChainId;
    address initialOwner;
}
```
